extracted.intended_audience: research administrators, grant applicants, policy analysts, and historians tracking research funding
extracted.subtask_description: Extract structured metadata from a historical catalog/listing of research project awards (titles, PIs, institutions, program codes, durations, and amounts). Useful for building databases of funded projects or analyzing funding patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH PROJECT SUPPORT
rubrics_metrics.description: Heading that groups awards under the general program/category labeled 'SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH PROJECT SUPPORT'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research field / discipline (section headings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level and subsection headings that classify awards by discipline or topic (examples from page: 'ATMOSPHERIC SCIENCES AND EARTH SCIENCES', 'ATMOSPHERIC SCIENCES', 'EARTH SCIENCES').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to group and index awards by scientific domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: State / geographic heading
rubrics_metrics.description: State or region headings that precede institution lists (examples: 'ALASKA', 'ARIZONA', 'CALIFORNIA').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the U.S. state or regional grouping for the institution(s) listed beneath it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution / organization
rubrics_metrics.description: The named recipient institution of the award (examples: 'UNIV OF TEXAS AT AUSTIN', 'UNIVERSITY OF WASHINGTON SCHOOL OF MEDICINE', 'CALIFORNIA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary organizational recipient where the project will be conducted or administered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal investigator(s) / named investigator(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Person(s) listed as responsible for the project, shown in 'LAST, FIRST' format (examples: 'POPOVICH, ROBERT P', 'GUY, ARTHUR W').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include multiple names separated by 'AND' indicating co-PIs or collaborators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project title / brief description
rubrics_metrics.description: The project title or short descriptive phrase for the research effort (examples: 'RESEARCH INITIATIVES - MASS TRANSFER IN THE ARTIFICIAL KIDNEY SYSTEM', 'MICROWAVE INTERACTIONS WITH AUDITORY SYSTEMS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often presented in all caps; serves as the primary human-readable summary of project scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program / grant code
rubrics_metrics.description: Alphanumeric codes in parentheses following titles that appear to identify program, project, or proposal codes (examples: '(KOJidJO)', '(A0JiiO 001)', '(AOJ105t 001)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for cross-referencing internal program identifiers, contracts, or proposal tracking numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: The funded project period expressed in months as shown on each entry (examples: '12 MONTHS', '24 MONTHS', '3 MONTHS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the length of the funding/support period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding amount (dollar value)
rubrics_metrics.description: The dollar amount awarded for the project shown with a leading '$' (examples: '$16,000', '$127,000', '$154,900').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary award associated with the listed duration and project; may be annual, total, or otherwise specified by the catalog format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award purpose / special award notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit labels or phrases indicating special purposes or award subtypes embedded in titles or notes (examples: 'DOCTORAL DISSERTATION RESEARCH', 'TASK ORDER FOR PARTIAL SUPPORT OF THE U. S. NATIONAL COMMITTEE', 'OTHER PROGRAM AWARDS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies awards intended for specific activities (student dissertation support, committee support, task orders) rather than standard research project grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration indicator (multiple investigators / co-PIs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Presence of multiple investigator names (e.g., 'X, AND Y') or joint institutional listings indicating collaborative or multi-investigator projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals multi-party research efforts; may affect interpretation of institutional credit and budget allocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student/trainee support identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries explicitly indicating student-focused support such as 'DOCTORAL DISSERTATION RESEARCH' or 'DOCTORAL DISSERTATION RESEARCH IN THE ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marks awards intended to fund graduate student research or dissertation work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contract/administrative support entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries that denote administrative or non-research support mechanisms (examples: 'SUPPORT OF THE U. S. NATIONAL COMMITTEE FOR GEOCHEMISTRY', 'TASK ORDER FOR PARTIAL SUPPORT').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes programmatic/administrative funding from investigator-led research grants.
